description: Edge case: File with unicode/emoji modified externally, hash handles correctly
prompt:
1. Read file with unicode:
<context-item use="read-file">
{"path": "src/unicode.js"}
</context-item>

2. Edit it using replace-text:
<action execute="replace-text">
{"path": "src/unicode.js", "old_str": "export const GREETING = ", "new_str": "export const GREETING = '你好 世界 🌍'; // was "}
</action>

NOTE: File contains emoji/unicode and will be modified externally. Hash should handle non-ASCII correctly.
